column7: A cached PAT was re-checked on every request against its own row only (revoked, expired), never its owner, so a PAT whose owner was suspended, deactivated, deprovisioned or deleted kept authenticating from the auth cache for up to validTokenTTL on every replica holding it whenever the credential sweep that marks the PATs revoked did not complete. CurrentPATRestriction now reads the owner in the same statement as the token (GetPersonalAccessTokenWithOwnerByHash, still one storage read per cache hit) and returns ErrPATOwnerNotActive, which serveAuthCacheHit denies and evicts on; a failed read refuses 503 (CACHE-FAILCLOSED-1). The machine-token sibling is mi-suspend-cachehit-001 (#2518). Siblings: TestCacheHit_PATOwner{Deactivated,Deprovisioned,Deleted}_DeniedAndEvicted, TestCacheHit_PATOwnerReadFails_RefusedNotServed; core half TestCurrentPATRestriction_OwnerNotUsable_ReturnsOwnerNotActive. Red at origin/main 4c6117702 (scripts redproof.sh: 200 where 401 is required). Found by the #2693 atomicity-exempt review.
